runtime/desktop/72-v30-touch-seat.rules.origin: Local r39 compact TTY and optional manual GUI integration
runtime/desktop/72-v30-touch-seat.rules.adaptation: Weston/Pixman memory-shadow plus software rootful Xwayland failed physical quality acceptance too; Phoc/fbdev failures retained in manual-desktop documentation. Chinese input passed the earlier native GTK3 profile and isolated current-backend readback; two separately authorized r40 RAM display diagnostics verified early-flip timing but physical retest still showed horizontal strips and latency. Direct KMS and full redraw also failed; a lightweight keyboard improved clicks but increased strips, and official immutable-buffer modetest reproduced them below GUI components. The r42 clock candidate black-screened and was rejected; r46 SCR1 parameter candidate passed audits but failed one authorized bare-DRM RAM test with unchanged strips; GUI skipped and default cellular/IMS/services restored, authorization closed. Unchanged r35 default and services restored, no partition flash or fresh call/SMS test.
